definition: Way of the Future (WOTF) is the first known religious organization dedicated to the worship of artificial intelligence (AI).
details: It was founded in 2017 by American engineer Anthony Levandowski.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Way of the Future.
